searchDescription: Official website of Kiminou Knox, a ten-time published author, NCAA-registered athlete, speaker, KimYaps podcast host, and creative voice from the Bay Area.
shortBio: Kiminou Knox is a ten-time published author, Bay Area poet, NCAA-registered basketball player, speaker, and creator of the Black Boy Lie universe. His books span poetry, faith, identity, love, family, and youth storytelling. He was a top essay finalist at the 2025 Miles Hall Foundation Youth Summit.
catalogEditionNote: The bibliography contains ten distinct published books. Original and remastered formats are cataloged as editions of those books, not counted as additional titles.
